His wife has observed a decline in his memory, taking note of his forgetfulness in paying bills, a task she has since had to assume.

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. Does the tremor seem to improve or disappear when you are actively using your hand, such as holding a cup or reading? Additionally, have you noticed any stiffness in your limbs or a slowing down of your general movements?

text: My main symptom is Resting tremor worse on the left hand. I also have Soft speech, Reduced facial expressions, Memory decline, Difficulty in managing finances.

speaker: Doctor

text:
The combination of a unilateral resting tremor, rigidity, bradykinesia (evidenced by soft speech and reduced facial expression), and cognitive decline strongly points to Parkinson's disease, possibly with early dementia. Given the classic motor signs and the exclusion of acute structural brain issues via MRI, I am confident in this clinical diagnosis.
